item.title: 【UPSCALED】Snoop Dogg - Murder Was The Case (versions in 4K and 1080p with ALAC audio)
item.description:
All screenshots are from the 4K version.




















Notes: A real cla$$ic, I love the cinematography of this one. I made the 4K upscale first in ProRes and then downgraded it to 1080p.

Source: MXF 512i master + LPCM audio from VOB (uncensored) + some bits from the master audio for the spoken parts and sound effects.

Codec #1: 2160p (4K) HEVC video/Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio/MP4 container
Codec #2: 1080p (Full HD) H264 video/Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio/MP4 container
